# KaTeX build dependency

Version 0.19.1. MIT license; see katex.LICENSE.txt.

The minified official distribution is used only at build time to convert authored LaTeX into native MathML. The finished website makes no request to a math CDN.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.19.1/dist/katex.min.js
